frontier.hypothesis: An ORDINARY-C construct exists that puts >= 64 extra loop-carried RTL insns in front of count_loop_regs_set and dies inside loop_optimize — the same channel the s6 proof used, spelled naturally instead of as balanced noise.
frontier.mechanism: loop-carried SETs are opaque to cse1's value numbering (toplev.c:2865) so they reach count_loop_regs_set; a biv whose only use is post-loop is removed entirely by strength_reduce's biv elimination inside loop_optimize, after move_movables has already consumed insn_count and before local-alloc can see the pseudo (K18).
